content: We need a template that does SN2: breaking halide, forming amine (nucleophile attack). Functional groups broken: halide. Formed: amine (maybe primary/secondary). Actually SN2 with nucleophile like OH- etc. But they want C-N formed and C-Cl broken, so halide broken, amine formed (maybe primary amine). Use functional_groups_formed: ["primary amines"] maybe.
